action.objective: Verify the reserved suggestion c4b5 at full depth, checking that the bishop retreat handles Black's queen and knight pressure without material loss.
action.rationale: Broad depth-2 search suggests c4b5 with exact score 561, PV c4b5 Bg4 Bxc6 Nxc6. Black queen on c6 and knight on f6 pressure the center; the bishop retreat to b5 attacks the queen and may win tempo. The main risk is Black's light bishop pinning or trading on f3, or d5xc4 winning the bishop after a retreat. I will verify c4b5 at depth 4 with the reserved 2000 nodes to confirm no tactical refutation.
